newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips rally to fifth record in last six sessions.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips rally to fifth record in last six sessions.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks rolled to another record Tuesday, the fifth in the last six sessions, bolstered by financial stocks that gained on falling long-term interest rates.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 53.42 points to close at 8,174.53. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 17-11 margin on moderate volume of about 548 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
